value: Orphaned Gas Town and tmux processes in tests are now cleaned up using a robust process group and custom tmux socket scanning logic in internal/testutil/safe_runner.go.
Schema documentation must adhere to ADR 0008, specifically using Architect-voice and documenting ForceNew/Computed behaviors. Rig deletion must mention docking (ADR 0003).
Terraform 1.7+ mock_provider is recommended for testing provider logic without spawning real Gas Town processes.
